newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says Italy must raise age for pension.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy must raise age for pension.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Friday that Italy should raise the qualifying age for pensions and people should no longer count on early retirement.
"In the face of restricted resources, we should raise the working age," Prodi told an end-of-year news conference. "We can no longer continue with early pensions."
Prodi said pensions should be reserved for the elderly who needed them most and Italy should grant them "a decent living"

Italy is due to begin a review of a 1995 pension deal in 1998 but Prodi wants discussion to start next year. Union leaders oppose bringing forward the review which commentators say is vital to complete the overhaul of Italy's creaking public finances.
